blocks.html: A facet to compute alongside a search query's hits.

types.name: SearchFacetRequest
types.description: A facet to compute alongside a search query's hits.

children.name: field
children.description: The dotted path of the field to facet on.

children.name: type
children.description:
Count the documents per distinct value of the field. This is the default
facet type.

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of facet values to return.

children.name: sort
children.description: Whether to order the returned values by their count or alphabetically.

children.name: query
children.description: Restrict the returned facet values to those matching this string.

children.name: ranges
children.description: The ranges to count the documents of.

children.name: key
children.description: A key identifying the range in the result.
